name: General chain (no playbook)
state: the shared chain as it runs today

signed.ruling: the general chain stays the fallback for any format without its own playbook: "as opposed to just having a general workflow for all ads"

what: Every setting here is the shared chain's own (THE-CHAIN.md, providers.json, RUN-PROTOCOL.md). null = the shared chain decides; a family playbook overrides only what it names.

edit.method: video-edit machine cut, or the editor hand-off

quality_bar: the shared QC gate: inspector + director verdicts on every clip

workflow.what: Draft reviewed production intake; generation is outside this fallback recipe.

steps.name: Accepted writing brief
steps.does: The writing chain runs with the decision layer on: python3 components/video-writing/machine/run.py {teardown} --autonomous (the teardown or scratch run's label). Every structure, hook, audit, swipe-match and manifest hold is decided from the owner's past calls and filed for him to overrule; the run continues. A run that still stops is diagnosed and fixed in the session, never sent to the owner. Retain the actual writing run and maker brief; a held or stale brief is not complete and goes back to writing, never around it. Writing costs are never quoted.

steps.name: Brief review
steps.does: The decision layer (video-teardown decide.py) passes this exact version from the owner's past calls and files the call in runs/decisions/calls.jsonl for him to agree with or overrule later; the run continues and nothing waits for him. An overruled version goes back to its authoring station.

steps.name: Prepare production plan
steps.does: Read the resolved existing family and style, then author the scene/asset/cast plan, exact component steps, missing inputs, estimate and stopping point. This draft fallback is reviewed planning coverage, not a proven end-to-end production recipe. Do not generate.
